extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia editors and readers attempting to create, find, or troubleshoot a category page (here: 'Sock puppet accounts')
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for creating, locating, or diagnosing a missing Wikipedia Category page (specifically for 'Sock puppet accounts'), including steps to check for existing coverage, capitalization/redirect issues, deletion, and account requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account requirement to create category
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account to create this page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create the category directly because you are not logged in, either log in/create an account or request the creation of a new category (via community channels).

rubrics_metrics.name: Check existing categories for coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Please browse through the existing categories to check if this category is covered under another name.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search for 'Sock puppet accounts' in existing pages within the Category namespace before creating a new category to avoid duplication or overlapping categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Checking inbound links helps determine whether the category already functions under a different name or whether pages should be retagged rather than creating a new category.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider alternative capitalizations and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants and, where appropriate, create redirects rather than duplicate category pages so users find the canonical category regardless of capitalization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delay/refresh for recently created pages
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you believe the category was just created but isn't showing, wait briefly and use the purge/reload functions to refresh the category listing before attempting to recreate it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if page missing
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the deletion log to learn why a category was removed and follow the appropriate remediation (e.g., discuss on talk pages, request undeletion, or modify proposal) rather than recreating it blindly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Empty category notice
rubrics_metrics.description: There are no pages or files in this category.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An empty category listing indicates no current members; consider whether pages should be added to the category, whether the category is necessary, or whether a different existing category covers the topic.
